_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil stat (5% directional resolution in 12h windows) and analyst's 19% direction accuracy demand HOLD as base rate — no specific breaker has been identified to override the statistical default despite the compelling bottom analog.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction; narrative leans bullish accumulation but does not issue a directional call, creating an implicit tension between pattern-read caution and story-level optimism
next_move.confirmed_if: Stablecoin growth breaks above 45 AND MVRV z-score lifts above 30 with BTC holding $62k, showing genuine liquidity accumulation without leverage blow-up risk
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding spikes above 60 with BTC rejection at $65k signaling leveraged longs crowded into weak breakout, or VIX breaks 20 with DXY strengthening through 101
